title: SRS Discovery Contract (ext:discovery)
description: Defines DiscoveryQuery, TextSegment, and ConformanceScenario shapes for the ext:discovery extension (RFC-012).

DiscoveryQuery.description: A conjunction of zero or more structured filter predicates. An instance matches if and only if it satisfies all predicates whose values are specified (unspecified predicates are wildcards).

typeId.description: Exact match on Record.typeId. Only Tier 2 Records carry typeId; Tier 0 instances do not match this predicate.

typeNamespace.description: Exact match on Record.typeNamespace. Independent predicate; can be combined with typeId.

typeName.description: Exact match on Record.typeName. Independent predicate; can be combined with typeId.

containerId.description: Instance is a member of this container: instanceId ∈ effective(C), the recursive closure over the Container's declared memberInstanceIds entries (ids read flat) and childContainerIds (RFC-034 [R8]; I-118). Membership is declared — a contains Relation never contributes (RFC-034 [R4]); this replaces the pre-RFC-034 three-condition rule that included transitive contains traversal.

tag.description: AND-conjunction: the instance's tags array must contain ALL of the specified values. RFC-006 vocabulary resolution is applied before comparison when a Vocabulary is declared.

lifecycleState.description: Exact match on Record.lifecycleState (case-sensitive). Requires ext:lifecycle. Instances without a lifecycleState field do not match.

lifecycleStates.description: RFC-012 Rev 11 (srs#525) — inclusive multi-value lifecycle filter, OR semantics: matches an instance whose Record.lifecycleState equals ANY listed value. An instance with no lifecycleState does not match when this predicate is present and non-empty. Independent of the exact-match lifecycleState predicate above (do not combine the two on one query). Formerly SectionSource.type-query's own lifecycleStates axis (RFC-011 Change A, I-142); carried forward here as the SectionSource → DiscoveryQuery collapse's one query mechanism (srs#525). Requires ext:lifecycle; instances without ext:lifecycle declared MUST ignore this predicate.

excludeLifecycleStates.description: Exclusion filter (parity with the former RFC-011 type-query axis of the same name, now retired in its favor — srs#525): an instance whose Record.lifecycleState matches ANY listed value is excluded. Applied after lifecycleState/lifecycleStates. Lets an authored view declare default-hidden states (e.g. superseded, closed) while a client offers a runtime show-all override by passing an empty list. Requires ext:lifecycle; instances with no lifecycleState are never excluded by this axis.

tier.description: Instance tier filter. 0 = Note, 2 = Record. Tier 1 (TypedRecord) was removed (rfc-decision-53635966); the gap in numbering is retained deliberately for reference stability.

contentMatch.description: Free-text recall-floor predicate. The implementation MUST include every instance whose Text Projection contains at least one segment whose normalized text contains the normalized form of this string as a substring (NFC + Unicode simple lowercasing).

fieldFilters.description: RFC-056 [R1]: filters on a Tier 2 Record's own field values, all of which must hold (AND), in conjunction with every other predicate. An absent or empty list does not change the selection. Which tests a filter may carry, and how values compare, depend on the resolved Field's datatype (RFC-056 Change B, [R2]-[R8]).

FieldFilter.description: RFC-056: one test on one Field's value. Names the Field by fieldId (resolved by the rule that resolves a Type FieldAssignment's fieldId) and carries exactly one test. Whether a test, value type or bound kind fits the Field, and whether a date bound names a real date, cannot be expressed here; implementations check them (RFC-056 [R7], [R8]).

fieldId.description: The Field whose value is tested, by its bare UUID.

in.description: Holds when the field has a value and the value (for a list-valued field, any element) equals a listed value (RFC-056 [R3]).

notIn.description: Holds when the field has a value and no value (for a list-valued field, no element) equals a listed value. A field with no value never matches (RFC-056 [R3]).

range.description: Holds when the field has a value (for a list-valued field, any element) within the bounds, both included. On a date Field the bounds are dates, a year or month bound covering its whole period; on an integer or number Field they are numbers, compared exactly by decimal value (RFC-056 [R4]).

missing.description: true holds when the field has no value (absent, empty string, empty list or empty object); false when it has one (RFC-056 [R5]).

TextSegment.description: A single searchable unit in the Text Projection of an instance. Normalization (NFC + Unicode simple lowercasing) is applied at match time, not at segment construction time.

fieldId.description: UUID of the field definition for package-resolved fields; sentinel string for special segments: 'note-title', 'note-section', 'tag', 'label'.

fieldName.description: Field name (snake_case) for package-resolved fields; sentinel string for special segments matching fieldId sentinels; or NoteSection.name for named special segments.

text.description: The raw stored text value. Normalization is applied at match time.

ConformanceScenario.description: A single named test scenario for the discovery conformance fixture.

query.description: The DiscoveryQuery to execute against the fixture repo.

expectedInstanceIds.description: Minimum required result set. For exactMatch:true scenarios, this is also the maximum.

exactMatch.description: If true, the result set MUST equal expectedInstanceIds exactly (structured-filter scenario). If false, the result set MUST be a superset of expectedInstanceIds (content-match scenario).

expectedSegments.description: Optional. When present, the runner MUST additionally verify the exact ordered TextSegment sequence for one field of one instance — the segment COUNT and ORDER, which expectedInstanceIds/exactMatch alone cannot express (I-120's list-cardinality rule: one segment per array element, in array order).

ExpectedSegments.description: A structured expectation over the exact ordered list of TextSegments one field of one instance projects. Added by RFC-012 [R11] (srs#483) to make segment count and order testable, closing the gap left by expectedInstanceIds alone.

instanceId.description: The instance whose Text Projection is inspected.

fieldName.description: The TextSegment.fieldName to filter the instance's projection to before checking count and order.

segments.description: The exact ordered list of TextSegment.text values expected for fieldName. The runner MUST assert that the projected segment count equals segments.length and that segment i's text equals segments[i], for every i, in order.
